name: functiongemma-270m-local
purpose: Tiny local CPU action model for high-frequency micro-tasks, intent routing, tool selection, compact function calls and repetitive Godot editor operations.
training: SFT fine-tuning on verified Godot micro-task/function-call data distilled from research and agent trajectories.
vision_policy: The local model is text/function-call only. Images and video are interpreted by a multimodal stage, then converted to structured intent for the local model.
